pages.title: Hawking Absorber Plate
pages.text: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow of an evaporating black hole. Hawking radiation has a characteristic spectrum, and this plate absorbs it perfectly. It is warm on its front face, cool on the back, and very black.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hawking radiation was leaking away from my experiments. In the Casimir Vacuum Press I bonded a Metamaterial Sheet to Neutronium Plate, tuning the metamaterial to the black hole spectrum.
